Los Angeles remains in the lead with five points, earning one point for the Overtime loss."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Atlanta trailed 5-2 after Triples in a match that was just getting warmed up, with both teams trading huge putts and clutch shots down the stretch."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Justin Thomas came through with what would prove to be the shot of the match with Los Angeles leading 5-4 entering the 15"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":" hole, the par-5 Quick Draw. After duffing a chip on his third shot, Thomas regrouped to hole his next shot with a wedge and win the matchup against Sahith Theegala to send it to Overtime."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"“Getting beat is one thing, but I didn’t want to lose,” Thomas said. “I didn’t want to hand that over to them, and I felt like I would have done that if I didn’t chip in. So, I was glad the hole got in the way.”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Former Atlanta Falcons quarterback Matt Ryan was there to watch the action wearing an Atlanta Drive hat, sitting alongside Falcons owner Arthur Blank. I like what (Atlanta) is doing so far.”"}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"Ryan’s analysis would prove to be spot-on, with Atlanta later using its third and final Hammer for a two-point swing at the 13"},{"type":"text","value":"th","format":{"variants":["superscript"]}},{"type":"text","value":" hole, where Billy Horschel beat Justin Rose with a birdie to make it 5-4 in favor of Los Angeles with two holes to play."}]},{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"type":"text","value":"With new Hammer rules announced last week, each team now begins the match with three Hammers they can use at any point.
